dialog.title: Pair reader
dialog.insecureWarning: This page does not use a secure connection. Someone on your network could show you a fake code. Pair only on a network you trust.

mode.repair: A reader that takes over one I already have (after a reset or as a replacement)

dialog.connectionLost: Connection to the server lost. The status shown here may be out of date.
dialog.compare: Compare this code with the code on the reader
dialog.colourHint: Segment 1 blinks on the reader to mark the start.
dialog.readerWaiting: Waiting for confirmation at the reader
dialog.failed: Pairing failed. Start again to get a new code.
dialog.expired: Pairing timed out. Start again to get a new code.

reason.cancelled-at-reader: It was cancelled at the reader.
reason.cancelled-by-admin: It was cancelled in the admin interface.
reason.reader-disconnected: The reader disconnected before pairing finished.
reason.protocol: Something went wrong on the reader. Try again.
reason.expired: Not both sides confirmed within 5 minutes.
reason.internal: An error occurred on the server.

security.title: Pairing
security.immediateHint: These actions take effect right away. You do not need to save.
security.repairDescription: Use this after the pairing was reset on the reader, or when you swap in a different reader, for example after a defect. Name, machines and settings stay. The old pairing stops working right away.
security.revokeDescription: Disconnects this reader right away. It cannot be used until you pair it again.
security.noCandidate: No reader is waiting yet. Reset the pairing on the reader itself and wait until it shows up, then try again.
security.revokeMessage: The reader disconnects within a second and can no longer be used. It moves to Not paired in the reader list, where you can pair it again.

toPair.title: Not paired
toPair.description: Pair these readers before you can use or set them up. The reader must be switched on and connected.
toPair.notConnected: The reader is not connected right now. Switch it on and try again.
toPair.noResponse: The reader did not respond. Check that it is switched on and has the latest software, then try again.

picker.title: Pair {{name}}
picker.description: Choose the reader to use. It must show up here first: reset its pairing on the reader itself and wait a moment.
picker.empty: No reader is waiting yet. Reset the pairing on the reader itself and wait until it shows up here.
